gcp._note: This is a Network Management API VpcFlowLogsConfig resource (locations/global in its own API surface, even though its target_resource is a regional subnetwork -- hence scope.region is omitted here while target_resource_urn still carries the target subnet's own region). This VpcFlowLogsConfig is a DIFFERENT mechanism than subnet.gcp-shared-vpc-us-central1.json's own extensions.gcp.enable_flow_logs=true field (the Subnetwork resource's own built-in flow-log toggle) -- both can independently exist for the same subnet; this example represents the separate, more configurable Network Management API config. Per resources.py::ObservabilityReference's own docstring, this record and every conformant adapter populating it carries configuration/delivery metadata only -- never actual log record contents.
